title: eol-normalizer telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the eol-normalizer hook. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "eol-normalizer". Evolves additive-only.

tool.description: Claude Code tool that triggered the hook (Write or Edit).

file.description: Path of the checked file, relative to the consuming repo root.

action.description: Outcome for the file's line endings: "skip" (already canonical or not applicable) | "lf" (normalized to LF) | "crlf" (normalized to CRLF). Documented value set, not a closed enum.
